objective: Audit how the SimpleMOS TDR and solved SDevice states represent the Silicon/SiO2 interface, determine whether geometric nodes are duplicated or shared with region-specific field support, verify electrostatic-potential continuity and semiconductor-only carrier support, and identify how the gate voltage boundary is attached without changing the deck.

definitions.geometric_duplicate_nodes: different global node IDs with exactly equal exported x and y coordinates
definitions.shared_topology_interface_edge: an undirected edge that is a boundary edge of both Silicon_1 and Oxide_1 using the same global endpoint IDs
definitions.region_specific_field_support: separate per-region field records keyed by the same shared global interface node ID
definitions.potential_continuity: Silicon_1 and Oxide_1 ElectrostaticPotential values at every shared interface node agree within the frozen tolerance
definitions.carrier_transport_support: eDensity, hDensity, eCurrentDensity, and hCurrentDensity are present only on Silicon_1
definitions.gate_boundary_attachment: the gate contact node set is attached to Oxide_1 while source, drain, and substrate are attached to Silicon_1

topology: count global nodes and exact duplicate-coordinate groups
count shared Silicon/SiO2 interface edges and nodes
verify contact-to-region attachments for all eight TDRs
solved_states: verify separate Silicon and SiO2 electrostatic-potential field supports on shared interface node IDs
verify carrier density and current-density fields are Silicon-only
record quasi-Fermi plot-field supports without treating insulating-region plot values as active carrier equations
analysis.deck_audit: verify the frozen M8 deck has no explicit HeteroInterface, Thermionic, Discontinuity, CurrentWeighting, or DirectCurrent interface/current override

classifications.shared_topology_continuous_potential_ins: no exact geometric duplicates, a nonempty shared-edge Si/SiO2 interface, region-specific potential supports with continuous values, gate on Oxide_1, other contacts on Silicon_1, and carrier density/current support only on Silicon_1
classifications.explicit_geometric_double_nodes: the Si/SiO2 interface uses exact co-located nodes with different global IDs
classifications.potential_discontinuity_observed: shared interface topology is complete but the regional electrostatic potentials exceed the continuity tolerance
classifications.support_or_topology_incomplete: required topology, contact attachment, solved field support, or state count is missing

analysis.claim_guard: M56 describes the representation used by this frozen SimpleMOS TDR/deck. It does not claim that every Sentaurus heterointerface uses the same strategy and does not authorize adding interface physics.

forbidden_work: adding or testing HeteroInterface, Thermionic, Discontinuity, tunneling, fixed charge, trap, or interface-recombination physics
changing gate, source, drain, or substrate boundary conditions
HFS, SG, quasi-Fermi, BGN, SRH, mobility, contact-model, or production-default changes
interpreting oxide quasi-Fermi plot records as evidence of active oxide carrier transport equations
deliverables: regression test for topology, field support, and evidence hashes
